lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three A.M. You're asleep. Your AI clone just answered three hundred messages, in your voice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day two. A fan asks for your best advice. It replies with your jokes, your slang. They have no idea.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day five. A brand slides into your DMs at midnight. Your clone negotiates, and closes the deal at double your rate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day nine. It remembers every name. Every birthday. People start calling you the nicest creator online.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day fourteen. A stranger sends you a voice note. Thanks for talking me through last night. You've never spoken to them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day thirty. Your followers have doubled. Then you read one comment. Honestly? Your clone is nicer than you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sounds far-fetched? Instagram already lets you send an automatic DM to everyone who comments. Up to seven hundred and fifty an hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Want the setup? Follow @nxtlvlsocial.ai and comment CLONE. I'll send you the tool.
